<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 500" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    
    <!-- === STANDS AND CLAMPS === -->
    <!-- Base plate -->
    <rect x="180" y="440" width="220" height="10" fill="#333333" />
    <rect x="420" y="440" width="180" height="10" fill="#333333" />
    
    <!-- Vertical rods -->
    <rect x="230" y="100" width="10" height="340" fill="#555555" />
    <rect x="520" y="180" width="10" height="260" fill="#555555" />

    <!-- Clamp 1 (holding flask neck) -->
    <rect x="235" y="150" width="45" height="12" fill="#777777" />
    <path d="M 270 140 C 255 140, 255 170, 270 170" fill="none" stroke="#444444" stroke-width="6" />

    <!-- Clamp 2 (holding condenser) -->
    <rect x="445" y="270" width="80" height="12" fill="#777777" />
    <path d="M 445 260 C 430 260, 430 290, 445 290" fill="none" stroke="#444444" stroke-width="6" />

    <!-- === BUNSEN BURNER AND TRIPOD === -->
    <!-- Tripod stand -->
    <path d="M 130 440 L 160 300 L 220 300 L 250 440" fill="none" stroke="#444444" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Wire gauze -->
    <line x1="150" y1="300" x2="230" y2="300" stroke="#222222" stroke-width="6" />

    <!-- Bunsen burner -->
    <rect x="175" y="390" width="30" height="50" fill="#666666" />
    <ellipse cx="190" cy="390" rx="15" ry="5" fill="#888888" />
    <rect x="187" y="350" width="6" height="40" fill="#888888" />
    <!-- Flame -->
    <path d="M 190 350 Q 205 310, 190 275 Q 175 310, 190 350" fill="#ffaa22" opacity="0.7" />
    <path d="M 190 345 Q 198 320, 190 290 Q 182 320, 190 345" fill="#ffee66" opacity="0.9" />

    <!-- === DISTILLATION FLASK === -->
    <!-- Flask body (round bottom) -->
    <path d="M 190 230 C 140 230, 140 330, 190 330 C 240 330, 240 230, 190 230 Z" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    
    <!-- Sea water liquid inside flask -->
    <path d="M 152 285 Q 190 335, 228 285 C 235 310, 220 328, 190 328 C 160 328, 145 310, 152 285 Z" fill="#b0e0e6" opacity="0.6" />
    
    <!-- Neck and side arm -->
    <!-- Neck goes up, side arm goes down-right -->
    <path d="M 178 230 L 178 160 L 350 250 L 350 270 L 198 180 L 198 230" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <path d="M 178 160 L 198 160" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" /> <!-- top rim open -->

    <!-- Cork/Bung in flask -->
    <polygon points="172,165 204,165 198,190 178,190" fill="#d2b48c" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- === THERMOMETER === -->
    <line x1="188" y1="80" x2="188" y2="205" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="188" cy="205" r="5" fill="#ff0000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <!-- Temperature markings -->
    <line x1="192" y1="100" x2="196" y2="100" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="192" y1="130" x2="196" y2="130" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="192" y1="160" x2="196" y2="160" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- === LIEBIG CONDENSER (X) === -->
    <!-- Outer jacket -->
    <rect x="330" y="240" width="220" height="50" rx="10" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <!-- Inner tube -->
    <line x1="330" y1="265" x2="550" y2="265" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Water In (bottom/right end of jacket) -->
    <path d="M 525 290 L 525 320" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="525" cy="320" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="545" y="325" font-size="13">water in</text>

    <!-- Water Out (top/left end of jacket) -->
    <path d="M 355 240 L 355 210" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="355" cy="210" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="315" y="200" text-anchor="end" font-size="13">water out</text>

    <!-- Connection from flask sidearm into inner tube of condenser -->
    <!-- The side arm passes through rubber bung into condenser -->
    <polygon points="345,248 370,248 360,265 340,265" fill="#d2b48c" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- === RECEIVER === -->
    <!-- Conical flask / Beaker receiving pure water -->
    <path d="M 530 360 L 570 360 L 555 310 L 545 310 Z" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <!-- Neck & opening -->
    <rect x="545" y="295" width="20" height="15" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <!-- Pure water inside receiver -->
    <path d="M 534 348 Q 550 358 566 348 L 568 358 Q 550 366 532 358 Z" fill="#b0e0e6" opacity="0.6" />
    
    <!-- Adapter / delivery tube from condenser to receiver -->
    <path d="M 530 265 L 565 265 L 555 295" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <!-- Bung for receiver -->
    <polygon points="543,295 572,295 567,310 548,310" fill="#d2b48c" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- === LABELS AND ANNOTATIONS === -->
    <!-- Apparatus X label -->
    <line x1="435" y1="265" x2="435" y2="350" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="435" y="370" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" font-size="16">X</text>

    <!-- Sea water label -->
    <text x="125" y="290" text-anchor="end" font-size="14">sea water</text>
    <path d="M 130 285 L 155 295" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Pure water label -->
    <text x="610" y="340" font-size="14">pure water</text>
    <path d="M 605 336 L 565 336" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Fig caption -->
    <text x="350" y="475" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Fig. 4.1</text>

  </g>
</svg>

    <line x1="330" y1="265" x2="550" y2="265" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <line x1="330" y1="255" x2="550" y2="255" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <path d="M 330 235 C 345 235, 345 255, 330 255" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Water Out (top/left side of jacket, pointing up) -->

    <circle cx="355" cy="210" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Pure water inside receiver -->

    <!-- Delivery tube from condenser to receiver -->

issues: The Liebig condenser (apparatus X) is incorrectly drawn with the inner tube sloping downwards instead of being horizontal or gently sloping downwards in the correct standard distillation orientation, and more importantly, the cooling water jacket is connected in reverse relative to the standard setup (water in should be at the lower end, but here 'water in' points to the upper end near the collection flask, while 'water out' is at the top left near the distillation flask).

The thermometer bulb is placed far too low inside the neck of the flask (well below the side arm level), contradicting part (b) of the question which asks why the bulb is placed level with the side arm.

issues: The Liebig condenser is drawn at an incorrect angle (slanted downwards rather than horizontal or slightly inclined towards the receiver), which is non-standard and physically awkward for a setup with stands.

The thermometer is positioned incorrectly: the bulb is shown inside the bung/cork rather than just below the entrance of the side arm, and the stem extends vertically straight up through the cork at an unnatural angle relative to the flask neck.
The water in/out labels on the condenser are inverted or confusingly placed (water out is shown at the upper end, but the clamp and label arrangement is untidy and intersects supporting rods).
